name: Snowrealm Okroshkas
desc: A bowl of cold soup. Cooked ingredients are arranged evenly in a bowl, then covered with a sour cream-based broth. Some Snezhnayans challenge themselves to down a large bowl of this soup in one go on the coldest days, taking it as proof that they are warriors who can conquer the bitter cold.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
